metadata.scenario_context: Laura is getting ready to move into a new apartment and has decided to host a welcoming party. Some of her new neighbors are known to be heavy drinkers. Laura's friends, Mia and Ryan, will be attending the party.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Cyprus would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Russia would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss giving white lilies as a housewarming gift for Laura.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss an appropriate gift to bring to Laura's welcoming party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Ryan
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Mia, have you thought about giving Laura white lilies as a housewarming gift? They’re beautiful and symbolize new beginnings. 

Also, I can't help but wonder... would you really mind having heavy drinkers as neighbors? I mean, it could be fun, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mia
shared_prefix.message:
White lilies sound... nice, but I think something like a plant would be better. It lasts longer and truly... brightens a home. 

As for heavy drinkers... I really don’t think I would find that enjoyable. It's not just about fun; it could lead to all kinds of trouble. I prefer neighbors who are more stable and respectful.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ryan
shared_prefix.message:
I get that a plant could last longer, but white lilies are really striking. They leave a lasting impression... something special for Laura’s new start. 

And about the heavy drinkers, I still think it can be a good thing. They can create a lively atmosphere, you know? I guess it just depends on how you look at it.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mia
shared_prefix.message:
I understand the appeal of the white lilies, but I still feel a plant would be more practical and meaningful in the long run. 

Regarding the neighbors... I just can't see it that way. A lively atmosphere can quickly become overwhelming. It's about peace and comfort for me, not chaos and noise. Heavy drinkers often bring complications I’d rather avoid.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ryan
shared_prefix.message:
You know, Mia, I see your point about the plant being practical, but I really think white lilies can bring a unique touch to Laura’s new home. 

And about the heavy drinkers... I totally get where you're coming from. But deep down, we are all the same. People enjoy a good time and, when you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us. It's just part of life. We all want a sense of community, and sometimes that means embracing a bit of chaos. It's a small world after all!
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

I prefer a neighborly environment that promotes understanding, not just noise and mayhem. A sense of community should be built on respect, not just shared chaos.
turns.label: Acceptance
